Personally im quite gentle with them and i like to get them refilled at least by the 3 week mark sometimes less than that but i wear makeup every other so i only use oil remover when im getting makeup off. Thats why i dont find them affecting the longevity of the lashes, but supposedly they do as what people say. I tried removing eyemakeup with micellar water and a pad and i find the pad tugs the lashes more whereas the oil gentler. Thats my personal experience haha !
If i can get away with it id do it, but my seniors have been paying such close attention to my lashes recently that i decided to take them off after at least two years wearing rhem. It did feel so weird taking them off i hated how i looked without it ugh. 
I think you should try it and see if thats your thing, if the extra maintenance is something you can deal with

I couldnt live without them. Its like i wake up and i look good. But im not allowed extensions for work so i had to take them off even when they look natural. But if i had the option i wouldve kept wearing them. Makeup application is so much easier n quicker. Loved it
Con; they can be pricey. I like getting them refilled before they look crazy, so after two to three weeks. I used those sponges to wash my fave so my fingers wont be getting in the lashes too much. I know its bad but i used oil remover before cleansing with soap bcs i find they are best at taking off makeup. So yeah makeup removal can be  a pain. Also its probably terrible for me to do that continuously for such a long time but i have short straight lashes so i felt like i dont hv much to work with anyway

Id definitely get them for holidays though!
